TOURISM & PLACE · RELEASE 20 SEPTEMBER 2026

Data and methodology note

Purpose and sample

Help tourism boards and destination planners compare national demand and identify evidence needed before promoting tourism. The 16-country sample comes from the original top-15 energy-consuming countries plus Croatia; it is not representative of world tourism.

Collection and processing

Published national aggregates were downloaded from OECD, Eurostat and World Bank/ICAO interfaces, with arrivals and receipts transcribed from OECD tables and China/India releases. Canada’s published resident survey and illustrative UNESCO attractions supplement these records. Country names and codes link the observations. All 49 original energy fields are retained; 47 tourism fields give 96 columns across 16 rows.

Checks confirm the record count, preserved energy values, units, years and blank handling. Sources were accessed on 20 September 2026. Tourism generally refers to 2024; airline activity to 2023; electricity prices to December 2025. This is a static snapshot.

Coverage and definitions

Available countries: arrivals 14/16; receipts 12/16; inbound nights 9/16; monthly nights and bed places 3/16 each (Croatia, France, Germany); airline passengers 16/16; resident feedback 1/16 (Canada).

Arrivals count trips under differing definitions, not unique people. Receipts are current-USD travel exports excluding international passenger transport, not profit. Monthly nights include domestic and international guests. Peak concentration = the two largest monthly counts ÷ the sum of all 12 months × 100; incomplete series are excluded. Airline figures cover national carriers, not routes or inbound visitors. UNESCO places are illustrative.

Missing data, uncertainty and privacy

Blanks mean unavailable, never zero; no values are estimated. Uneven reporting, accommodation thresholds, exchange rates, survey uncertainty and the UK/Great Britain coverage break limit comparisons. National patterns cannot establish local crowding, spare capacity, resident support or causal effects. The site collects no personal information through forms, accounts, analytics or location requests.

Sources and reproducibility

OECD tourism · Eurostat nights · Eurostat capacity · World Bank/ICAO · UNESCO. China, India and Canada release links, metric-specific sources and definitions are retained in the CSV and processing notes. Archived downloads support reproducibility; review current releases before operational decisions.
